ess.title: Electronic Sales System
ess.shortDescription: From the browser: issue e-invoices and e-receipts, send them to the tax authority, and track status — no software to install.
ess.description: ESS is the electronic sales system for businesses that need certified e-invoices and e-receipts. You work in the browser: create the document, review it, submit it to the Egyptian Tax Authority, and follow acceptance or rejection in one place. Manage items, customers, and suppliers; register branches and POS devices; and code your items on the tax portal. Legal signing happens with a USB token on your PC through ESA — without installing invoicing software on every machine.
features: Issue and manage e-invoices: create, edit, and adjustments
Sales receipts and returns with submit-and-track to the tax authority
Ready master data: items, customers, suppliers, and bulk import
Tax portal view: recent documents, GPC codes, and coding requests
Multi-company, branches, POS devices, and user permissions
Print A4, A5, or thermal with templates that match your business

ers.title: POS E-Receipts
ers.shortDescription: A fast cashier screen to issue e-receipts and link them to the tax authority — without the full invoice workflow.
ers.description: ERS is built for retail and point-of-sale teams that need an e-receipt at the cashier — not an invoice. The cashier picks items, issues the receipt, and sends it to the Egyptian Tax Authority. You manage POS devices, branches, and customers, and import receipts when needed. The dashboard shows accepted, rejected, and net daily sales so you can follow the shift from anywhere.
features: A simplified cashier path: sales receipts and returns
POS devices and branches linked to the tax authority
Items, customers, and bulk receipt import
View receipts, line items, and accept/reject status
Print templates suited to cashiers and thermal printers
Daily sales board: valid, in process, and net for the shift

esa.title: Electronic Signature Agent
esa.shortDescription: A Windows agent that signs your invoices and receipts from a USB token before they reach the tax authority — the PIN is never saved on disk.
esa.description: ESA is an electronic signature agent for Windows 10 and 11. Plug in a USB token (certified e-signature or e-seal), log in with your PIN, and the agent signs the document to ITIDA and tax-authority standards. It detects the token the moment you insert or remove it, and works locally with ESS on the same PC through a secure interface that never leaves the machine. For companies with many PCs, signing can run across devices without moving the certificate. It supports the token brands most used in Egypt, and warns you before a certificate expires so issuance does not stop.
features: E-signature and e-seal from a USB token on Windows
Instant detection when a token is plugged in or removed
PIN stays in memory only — never written to disk, cleared on logout
Secure local link with ESS on the same PC
More than one token on the same machine for higher signing volume
Certificate expiry alerts and PIN change from the interface
